findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

Observed no active sani bucket present in the kitchen with cooking being conducted. Discussed with PIC. Ensure a sani bucket with appropriate concentration is available during all operational hours. PIC made a bleach sani bucket for the Inspector - 200 ppm. COS.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Observed the following areas in need of cleaning:
1. Ceiling in storage area has dust - clean the ceiling to rid dust.
2. Fans inside 3-door reach-in cooler have dust on grates - clean interior ceiling fans.

Discussed routine cleaning with PIC. Ensure kitchen is maintained free of dust. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following physical facility areas in need of repairs:
1. Hand sink in the kitchen has no caulking - caulk the hand sink to the wall.
2. Flooring by the kitchen storage (across from the 3-door reach-in cooler) has a piece of flooring missing. Repair the floor so it is smooth and easily cleanable for moping.
3. The 3 compartment sink has moldy caulking - re-caulk the sink.
4. Men’s bathroom hand sink has no caulking - caulk sink the wall.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. 

Mice droppings in dry storage-appear to be old. Foods and condiments are stored in sealed totes, all food appeared to be in sound condition at time of inspection. Does not appear mice got into plastic totes. Ensure droppings are removed from facility, eliminate harborage conditions. Scouts swept dry storage at time of inspection. 

A small gap in the lower right hand corner of screen door in kitchen observed. Ensure a door sweep is installed to properly seal inside from pests and rodents.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12 (P) Food handler was observed turning off the faucet with their bare hands. The PIC was suggested to review hand washing practices with food handlers at the facility.
